---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

project_dir <- file.path(path.expand("~"), "Downloads", "AC_combined_analysis", "Adriana_analysis")
tables_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "tables")
figures_dir <- file.path(project_dir, "figures")
output_dir  <- file.path(project_dir, "output_tables")

dir.create(figures_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(output_dir, showWarnings = FALSE)
```

```{r libraries}
library(tidyverse)
library(mitch)
library(org.Sc.sgd.db)
library(AnnotationDbi)

# pin dplyr::select after loading annotation packages
select <- dplyr::select
```

```{r load-data}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# PCA_genes_AC.txt: gene-level PC scores
# Only PC1/PC2 carry meaningful signal (PC4+ is noise)
# ---------------------------------------------------------
pca_genes <- read_tsv(file.path(tables_dir, "PCA_genes_AC.txt"), show_col_types = FALSE)
```

```{r build-go-genesets}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Build GO gene sets locally from org.Sc.sgd.db.
# Gene set names use GO term descriptions (not IDs) so plots
# are human-readable. Term descriptions fetched via GO.db.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("Building GO gene sets from org.Sc.sgd.db...\n")

if (!requireNamespace("GO.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
  BiocManager::install("GO.db")
}
library(GO.db)

build_go_genesets <- function(ontology) {
  go_map <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    org.Sc.sgd.db,
    keys    = keys(org.Sc.sgd.db, keytype = "ORF"),
    columns = c("GO", "ONTOLOGY"),
    keytype = "ORF"
  ) %>%
    filter(ONTOLOGY == ontology, !is.na(GO)) %>%
    dplyr::select(ORF, GO)

  # look up human-readable term names from GO.db
  go_ids <- unique(go_map$GO)
  go_terms <- AnnotationDbi::select(
    GO.db,
    keys    = go_ids,
    columns = "TERM",
    keytype = "GOID"
  ) %>%
    dplyr::rename(GO = GOID)

  go_map <- go_map %>%
    left_join(go_terms, by = "GO") %>%
    mutate(label = if_else(!is.na(TERM), paste0(TERM, " (", GO, ")"), GO))

  # build named list: term label -> vector of ORF gene IDs
  go_map %>%
    group_by(label) %>%
    summarise(genes = list(unique(ORF)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    deframe()
}

go_genesets_bp <- build_go_genesets("BP")
go_genesets_mf <- build_go_genesets("MF")
go_genesets_cc <- build_go_genesets("CC")

go_genesets <- c(go_genesets_bp, go_genesets_mf, go_genesets_cc)

cat("Gene sets built:",
    length(go_genesets_bp), "BP |",
    length(go_genesets_mf), "MF |",
    length(go_genesets_cc), "CC |",
    length(go_genesets), "total\n")
```

```{r prepare-input}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# mitch input format: a data frame with rownames = gene IDs
# and one column per contrast (PC score here).
# Running PC1 and PC2 as a single two-contrast mitch call
# enables the multi-dimensional enrichment that is mitch's
# key advantage - it can find gene sets that respond
# consistently or divergently across both PCs simultaneously.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
mitch_input <- pca_genes %>%
  select(gene_id, PC1, PC2) %>%
  column_to_rownames("gene_id")

cat("mitch input dimensions:", nrow(mitch_input), "genes x", ncol(mitch_input), "contrasts\n")
cat("Contrasts:", colnames(mitch_input), "\n")
```

```{r run-mitch}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# mitch enrichment.
# priority = "effect" ranks results by effect size (s.dist),
# which is the standard approach recommended in the mitch
# documentation and matches what Adriana's previous student
# used for the TF enrichment analysis.
# cores = 1 for reproducibility; increase for speed if needed.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
cat("Running mitch enrichment (PC1 + PC2 jointly)...\n")

mitch_result <- mitch_calc(
  x        = mitch_input,
  genesets = go_genesets,
  priority = "effect",
  cores    = 1
)

cat("mitch complete.\n")
cat("Total gene sets tested:", nrow(mitch_result$enrichment_result), "\n")

# Filter to significant results (p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05)
mitch_sig <- mitch_result$enrichment_result %>%
  filter(p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05) %>%
  arrange(p.adjustMANOVA)

cat("Significant gene sets (p.adjustMANOVA < 0.05):", nrow(mitch_sig), "\n")
```

```{r plot-pc1-effect}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 1: top 20 gene sets ranked by PC1 effect size (s.PC1),
# coloured by direction - matches the single-contrast view
# from scripts 01-03 for direct comparison
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_mitch_single <- function(df, pc_col, title, n_top = 20) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No significant terms for:", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  df_top <- df %>%
    arrange(desc(abs(.data[[pc_col]]))) %>%
    slice_head(n = n_top) %>%
    mutate(
      set_short = if_else(
        nchar(set) > 60,
        str_trunc(set, 60, ellipsis = "..."),
        set
      ),
      set_short = str_wrap(set_short, width = 40),
      set_short = fct_reorder(set_short, .data[[pc_col]]),
      direction = if_else(.data[[pc_col]] > 0,
                          "Positive\n(high PC score)",
                          "Negative\n(low PC score)")
    )

  ggplot(df_top, aes(x = .data[[pc_col]], y = set_short,
                     size = -log10(p.adjustMANOVA), color = direction)) +
    geom_point(alpha = 0.8) +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    scale_color_manual(values = c(
      "Positive\n(high PC score)" = "#d6604d",
      "Negative\n(low PC score)"  = "#4393c3"
    )) +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = paste("Effect size (s.", sub("s\\.", "", pc_col), ")", sep = ""),
      y = NULL,
      size = expression(-log[10]("adj. p-value")),
      color = "Direction"
    ) +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y     = element_text(size = 7),
      legend.position = "right"
    )
}

plot_mitch_single(mitch_sig, "s.PC1", "PC1 - GO enrichment (mitch, top 20 by PC1 effect size)")
```

```{r plot-pc2-effect}
plot_mitch_single(mitch_sig, "s.PC2", "PC2 - GO enrichment (mitch, top 20 by PC2 effect size)")
```

```{r plot-2d}
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Plot 2: 2D scatter of s.PC1 vs s.PC2 effect sizes -
# this is mitch's unique output unavailable from the other
# three methods. Gene sets in off-diagonal quadrants are
# enriched differently in PC1 vs PC2, i.e. they respond
# to the size-dependent TOR/PKA pathway axis but not the
# independent (mitochondrial) axis, or vice versa.
# Labelling the most extreme outliers in each quadrant.
# ---------------------------------------------------------
plot_mitch_2d <- function(df, title, n_label = 10) {
  if (nrow(df) == 0) {
    cat("No data to plot for:", title, "\n")
    return(NULL)
  }

  # Label the most extreme terms in each quadrant
  df_label <- df %>%
    mutate(
      quadrant = case_when(
        s.PC1 > 0 & s.PC2 > 0 ~ "Q1",
        s.PC1 < 0 & s.PC2 > 0 ~ "Q2",
        s.PC1 < 0 & s.PC2 < 0 ~ "Q3",
        s.PC1 > 0 & s.PC2 < 0 ~ "Q4"
      ),
      dist_from_origin = sqrt(s.PC1^2 + s.PC2^2)
    ) %>%
    group_by(quadrant) %>%
    slice_max(dist_from_origin, n = ceiling(n_label / 4)) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    mutate(label = if_else(
      nchar(set) > 40,
      str_trunc(set, 40, ellipsis = "..."),
      set
    ))

  ggplot(df, aes(x = s.PC1, y = s.PC2)) +
    geom_point(aes(color = -log10(p.adjustMANOVA)), alpha = 0.6, size = 1.5) +
    geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "grey50") +
    ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
      data = df_label,
      aes(label = label),
      size = 2.5, max.overlaps = 20
    ) +
    scale_color_gradient(low = "grey80", high = "#d6604d") +
    labs(
      title = title,
      x = "Effect size PC1 (s.PC1)",
      y = "Effect size PC2 (s.PC2)",
      color = expression(-log[10]("adj. p-value"))
    ) +
    theme_bw()
}

# ggrepel needed for labels - install if missing
if (!requireNamespace("ggrepel", quietly = TRUE)) {
  install.packages("ggrepel")
}
library(ggrepel)

plot_mitch_2d(mitch_sig, "GO enrichment - mitch 2D (PC1 vs PC2 effect sizes)")
```

```{r save-outputs}
# Save full significant results table
write_tsv(mitch_sig, file.path(output_dir, "go_mitch_pc1_pc2_significant.txt"))

# Save individual PC effect-size plots
p_pc1 <- plot_mitch_single(mitch_sig, "s.PC1",
                            "PC1 - GO enrichment (mitch)")
p_pc2 <- plot_mitch_single(mitch_sig, "s.PC2",
                            "PC2 - GO enrichment (mitch)")
p_2d  <- plot_mitch_2d(mitch_sig,
                        "GO enrichment - mitch 2D (PC1 vs PC2)")

if (!is.null(p_pc1)) ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "go_mitch_pc1.png"),
                             plot = p_pc1, width = 10, height = 9)
if (!is.null(p_pc2)) ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "go_mitch_pc2.png"),
                             plot = p_pc2, width = 10, height = 9)
if (!is.null(p_2d))  ggsave(file.path(figures_dir, "go_mitch_2d.png"),
                             plot = p_2d,  width = 10, height = 9)

cat("Done - results saved to output_tables/ and figures/\n")
```
